summary.zh: rc.3 验收小问题（#50）：project health 标题同时给出可见项数与展开项数；固定 ref 提示改称“插件最新版本”并在目标 tag 未知时明说；check --hook 使用 --latest / --offline / --client；update 的 Claude 汇总说明旧版本目录位置；check 合并同步盘与本机专属目录两行；英文界面标注迁移说明仅有中文；runtime status 的旁置目录措辞不再暗示内容更新；补充 Codex 候选版验收文档。
summary.en: rc.3 acceptance polish (#50): project health headings show both visible and expanded counts; the pinned-ref note says "plugin latest version" and states when the target is unknown; check --hook honours --latest / --offline / --client; the Claude update summary names where old version directories remain; check merges the sync-folder and machine-local lines; the English UI states that migration notes are Chinese-only; runtime status no longer implies newer content for side-by-side directories; Codex candidate acceptance is documented.
